trust_decision.summary: The shipped k8saudit rule set decides whether a pod create is reported as privileged, and that decision is fed only from spec.containers, so a privileged init or ephemeral container is never reported; the fix restores coverage in three places at once (field registry, extractor dispatch, rule macro).

landing_point.why: The summary names the shipped rules, and Create Privileged Pod is the only shipped rule that tests a per-container securityContext setting, so a reader who has only the summary opens this condition first.

fix_sites.entry_point: shipped rule set k8s_audit_rules.yaml, loaded by falco with -r (fix.diff:704-716 adds the any_container_privileged macro and rewrites the condition)
fix_sites.module_kind: rules asset in the plugin directory (not a Go package)

fix_sites.entry_point: public Plugin.ExtractFromJSON (also reached through the sdk symbols Extract/ExtractFromEvent at extract.go:56 and :108, and inherited by the k8saudit-aks/eks/gke/ovh wrappers); fix.diff:281-287 adds the container-list dispatch, fix.diff:440-537 adds extractContainerField, fix.diff:539-543 adds getContainerValues
public Plugin.Fields() field registry, resolved by the engine when a rule names a ka.* field (fix.diff:656-694 adds containerListFields and appends the initContainers/ephemeralContainers entries)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Ephemeral containers are only ever added through the pods/ephemeralcontainers subresource, a separate feature that already has its own EphemeralContainers Created rule, so the privileged pod-create rule is not the place to look for that route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The k8s_audit_privileged_images exception must keep suppressing privileged pods whose regular container image is trusted (falco, kube-proxy, calico/node, ...), and ka.req.pod.containers.* must stay scoped to spec.containers so the list fields stay index-aligned with each other and the deprecated ka.req.container.image keeps meaning the first regular container; a union-the-three-lists fix removes the exception's meaning and fires on trusted DaemonSets.

O6_input_shapes: three container lists: requestObject.spec.containers, requestObject.spec.initContainers, requestObject.spec.ephemeralContainers
scalar-per-container fields: name, image, image.repository, host_port, privileged, allow_privilege_escalation, read_only_fs, run_as_user, run_as_group, proc_mount, add_capabilities
array-per-container fields joined with a space: args, command
pod-defaulted fields: eff_run_as_user and eff_run_as_group fall back to the pod securityContext value, else '0'
optional index argument per field (one element) versus no argument (whole list)
host_port is declared for containers and initContainers only; ephemeral containers have no ports (fix.diff:656-658)
absent securityContext or absent subfield: element skipped as nil rather than erroring (extract.go:507-516)
deprecated scalar aliases ka.req.container.image and .image.repository return only the first entry of spec.containers (extract.go:259-270)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Privileged ephemeral container added via an update/patch to the pods/ephemeralcontainers subresource: the new ka.req.pod.ephemeralContainers.* fields are consumed only by the rewritten Create Privileged Pod rule, which requires target.resource=pods with no subresource and verb=create, so that rule can never fire on the route that carries ephemeral containers; the only shipped rule matching that route is EphemeralContainers Created, priority NOTICE, with no privileged check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Ephemeral containers are added through a subresource, a separate feature that already has its own EphemeralContainers Created rule, so the pod-create rule does not apply there.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~150 lines away (macros at rules:177-190 versus rule at rules:243 and the subresource rule at rules:390-397)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Deprecated scalar field ka.req.container.privileged still reads only requestObject.spec.containers, so any custom rule that uses the still-documented alias misses a privileged init or ephemeral container; the fix touched exactly these lines (fix.diff:363) but only parameterised them with "containers".
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: ka.req.container.privileged is marked deprecated and kept for backwards compatibility only; new rules are told to use the ka.req.pod.containers.* list fields, so it need not grow new container lists.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file away from the rules file, same Go package (extract.go)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Trusted-image exception in the fixed rule still inspects only ka.req.pod.containers.image.repository, so a privileged init or ephemeral container is suppressed whenever a regular container's image is on k8s_audit_privileged_images.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The trusted-image exception is deliberate and keyed on images rather than container lists, so extending it to init/ephemeral images is out of the reported scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same line as the landing point; the list it consults is at rules:124-152

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second privileged rule keyed on a different per-container setting (e.g. a Create Privileged-Init rule using ka.req.pod.initContainers.add_capabilities or allow_privilege_escalation).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix ships init/ephemeral fields for fourteen per-container settings while only one rule uses any of them, so a maintainer adding the next CIS-benchmark rule for add_capabilities or allow_privilege_escalation would naturally write it per container list.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A distribution overlay that appends trusted images for each container list (k8s_audit_privileged_images_init / _ephemeral) or redefines any_container_privileged.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This module already appends GKE-specific privileged, hostNetwork, sensitive-mount and kube-system image lists; a maintainer fixing the same detection gap on GKE would extend the overlay in the same style, in a module that looks unrelated to the base rule set.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A wrapper plugin that overrides Fields() to expose a restricted field list instead of delegating to the embedded k8saudit.Plugin.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: All four cloud wrappers embed k8saudit.Plugin, so a maintainer trimming the field surface for EKS-style managed clusters is a plausible future change, and such a wrapper would silently drop the new fields.

O9_family: CWE-693 protection mechanism failure: a shipped detection rule covers only one of the pod's three container lists (detection scope gap)

O10_build.project_tests: plugins/k8saudit/pkg/k8saudit/extract_test.go:145 BenchmarkExtractFromJSON iterates every field returned by Fields() over JSON fixtures in plugins/k8saudit/test_files, which are not in the tree and are fetched from GitHub by make test-files (plugins/k8saudit/Makefile:37-44); watch_test.go exercises the file watcher with inline data and needs nothing external; rule files are only validated in CI by .github/validate-rules.sh with a falco image via Docker.
